releases.title: Initial GTasks baseline
releases.summary: Introduced the local GBrain-backed task interface with Today, Inbox, Upcoming, Blocked, Projects, Goals, Completed, Quick Add, and verified task details.

releases.title: Reliable task workflow and Board
releases.summary: Added status editing, the task Board, and reciprocal goal links; normalized lifecycle relationships so every valid task stays visible exactly once without hidden-task issues.

releases.title: Next actions and automatic refresh
releases.summary: Added verified Next Action editing in task details and a visible read-only refresh every 30 minutes that coalesces requests, defers while hidden, and resumes when the page is visible.

releases.title: Durable projects and faster reads
releases.summary: Added verified GBrain project creation, persistent zero-task project cards, separate task assignment, and bounded parallel reads to reduce task-loading latency.

releases.title: Immediate verified status updates
releases.summary: Status changes now reconcile from canonical GBrain readback immediately; Board adds keyboard/touch movement and silent same-status no-ops. Projects are now limited to typed members of Tony's Projects, with first-use initialization and visible malformed-member diagnostics.

releases.title: Goal lifecycle controls and steadier reads
releases.summary: Added verified goal creation plus confirmed Pause and recoverable Delete workflows that preserve linked task content; capped GBrain read concurrency and coalesced duplicate initial loads while manual and automatic Refresh remain authoritative.
